items.title: Microgrid Management with Reinforcement Learning
items.description: Intelligent energy optimization and microgrid management using Deep Reinforcement Learning algorithms (DQN and PPO).
items.fullDescription: Comparative experimental study on intelligent energy management and optimization in electrical microgrids using Deep Reinforcement Learning algorithms (Deep Q-Network - DQN and Proximal Policy Optimization - PPO) versus rule-based controllers (RBC). Implemented with PyTorch and the Pymgrid simulator.

items.title: Artificial Bee Colony (ABC) for TSP
items.description: Optimization of the Traveling Salesperson Problem (TSP) using the bio-inspired Artificial Bee Colony (ABC) algorithm.
items.fullDescription: Modular implementation and comparative benchmark of the bio-inspired Artificial Bee Colony algorithm applied to the Traveling Salesperson Problem (TSP) on an empirical Luxembourg dataset instance. Includes mutation operator evaluation (swap, insertion, k-opt) and convergence analysis.

items.title: Semantic Segmentation for Autonomous Driving
items.description: Real-time semantic segmentation for autonomous vehicles on Cityscapes using U-Net and TensorRT GPU acceleration.
items.fullDescription: End-to-end real-time semantic segmentation pipeline for autonomous driving on the Cityscapes benchmark. Implements a U-Net architecture with a pretrained ResNet-34 encoder (transfer learning, gradual unfreezing, mIoU 0.6279), Bayesian hyperparameter optimization with Optuna, Gaussian tiling for high-resolution inference (1024×2048), and accelerated deployment with ONNX Runtime and TensorRT FP16.

items.title: Amazon Reviews Rating Prediction
items.description: Sentiment analysis and rating prediction on Amazon product reviews using Natural Language Processing (NLP).
items.fullDescription: Classification and sentiment analysis pipeline applied to Amazon customer product reviews. Features advanced NLP preprocessing (lemmatization, emoji parsing, TF-IDF vectorization) and performance benchmarking across supervised learning models (Logistic Regression, Naive Bayes, and KNN).

items.title: KNN Student Pass/Fail Classifier in C
items.description: K-Nearest Neighbors classifier built natively from scratch in pure C with low-level memory optimization to predict academic performance.
items.fullDescription: From-scratch native implementation of the K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN) algorithm in pure C without external ML libraries. Features low-level dynamic memory management and Euclidean distance optimizations for student academic success prediction.
